description: Cross-SDK EIP-712 debit authorization test vector (AIMarketEscrow.sol)
notes: Run: cd typescript && npm run build && npx vitest run test/cross_sdk_vectors.test.ts
signatureNotes: r||s||v over expectedDigest itself, v in {27,28}. RFC-6979 deterministic and low-s, so every SDK must reproduce these exact bytes. AIMarketEscrow.debitChannel runs ECDSA.recover over the digest, so a signature over keccak(digest) — what you get by handing a pre-computed digest to an API that hashes — reverts as InvalidSignature().
